points.title: Aggressive New YZF-R1 Inspired Face
points.description: With a glaring new look and face, a new front fairing and screen inspired by the iconic YZF-R1, the R25 has a central air duct working with the cross-layered panels to maximize cooling airflow for the engine, making this the most outstanding compact super sport in its class.

points.description: Selain daripada ketahanan dan kestabilan, enjin ini juga memberikan keseimbangan antara prestasi tork, kemudahan penggunaan dan penggunaan bahan api yang rendah.

points.title: Tayar Bercorak Blok
points.description: Tayar bercorak blok memberikan kestabilan yang baik sama ada di jalanraya mahupun di luar jalanraya.

points.title: Sistem Kunci Pintar

points.title: Sistem ‘Brek’ Optimum Dwi Saluran ABS Sistem kawalan ‘brek’ yang lebih optimum bagi menghalang penguncian roda secara tidak sengaja dan kegelinciran pada permukaan jalan licin.

points.description: Ruang yang lebih besar untuk menyimpan barangan keperluan penunggang serta aktiviti seharian.

points.title: Soket Kuasa Elektrik
points.description: Komunikasi tidak terputus dengan sokongan soket kuasa elektrik untuk mengecas alat peranti sepanjangan perjalanan.

points.title: Stylish exhaust

Intuitive Control Switch with a Dedicated Cruise Control
points.description: With just a convenient click, the new intuitive control switch can handle a wide range of functions, including smartphone connectivity, navigation and cruise control.

points.title: 5-Inch TFT Full Colour Display with Y-Connect & Garmin StreetCross
points.description: The 5-inch full-color TFT display is updated with four customisable themes and smartphone connectivity via the Y-connect app, allowing riders to receive calls, texts, and listen to music. Real-time traffic updates and full map navigation can be accessed through the free Garmin StreetCross app.

points.title: Acoustic Amplifier Grilles
points.description: Amplifier grilles are specially designed with perforated openings above the fuel tank to accentuate the high frequency sounds of the engine, delivering an exhilarating sound of speed right to the rider’s ears.

points.title: Personalized Riding Modes Via Yamaha Ride Control (YRC)
points.description: The Yamaha Ride Control (YRC) offers three preset riding modes-SPORT, STREET, and RAIN-plus two customizable options for engine power and electronic intervention, all adjustable via the TFT screen or through the Y-CONNECT app.

points.title: Brembo Brake Master Cylinder
points.description: The Brembo radial master cylinder delivers a linear pressure supply to the four-piston calipers on the dual 298mm front discs, providing outstanding braking performance with fingertip control.

points.title: Equipped with USB Type-C
points.description: A standard Type-C port for charging mobile and portable devices.

points.title: Redesigned Subframe and Spring Rate
points.description: The subframe has been redesigned to improve the rider’s stability while the spring rate has been increased to ensure better handling and cornering performance across various road conditions.

points.title: Reshaped Fuel Tank and Two-Part Seat
points.description: The redesigned fuel tank is now slimmer for a forward-learning riding position while the 2-part seat has been upgraded to provide comfort for both rider and passenger.

points.description: Smoother grip. More confident handling, rain or shine.

points.title: Emergency Stop Signal (ESS)
points.description: Smart signals that flash under hard braking so others around you react faster, when seconds matter.

points.title: ‘Fairing’ Depan Terbaru
points.description: Rekaan hadapan lebih agresif menyerlahkan simbol kuasa dan juga memberi makna tersendiri kepada mereka yang berani.

points.title: Meter Digital LCD Dengan Latar Negatif
points.description: Panel unit digital LCD baharu yang memaparkan informasi seperti kelajuan, tahap RPM, kedudukan gear, penunjuk VVA dan lain-lain.

points.title: Sistem Kunci Pintar
points.description: Enjin boleh dihidupkan dengan memutar butang tanpa perlu memasukkan kunci.

points.title: Sistem Brek ‘ABS’
points.description: Sistem brek ‘ABS’ serta piring depan lebih besar digabungkan bagi memberi kuasa pengendalian lebih dinamik dan keyakinan dalam setiap tunggangan.

points.title: Klac ‘Assist & Slipper’
points.description: Terhubung ke gearbox, sistem klac A&S memastikan penukaran gear yang lebih lancar dan mengurangkan tahap bebanan klac untuk perjalanan yang lebih selesa.

points.title: Twin Eyed Position and LED Headlight
points.description: Aggressive twin LED position lights gives an intimidating MT look, the compact central mounted LED headlight brightens every night ride.

points.title: Torque friendly acceleration VVA engine
points.description: 155cc liquid-cooled, SOHC, 4-valve, fuel-injected engine with high-performance VVA system integrating specific ECU with optimized FI settings produces high torque acceleration.

points.title: Inverted Front Fork
points.description: All new inverted front forks and cast aluminium upper triple clamp provides confident cornering and braking performance.

points.title: LCD Meter Panel
points.description: Negative LCD meter panel features easy to read multi-function display with a range of information.

points.title: 140mm Rear Tyre
points.description: Mounted with wide 140mm rear tyres for excellent grip and sure road holding.

points.title: A&S Clutch for Lighter Lever Pull & Stress-Free Gear Shifts
points.description: An A&S (assist and slipper) clutch is adopted to reduce the weight of the clutch pull and provide low-stress shifting during deceleration. The lighter clutch pull weight helps to reduce rider fatigue. This also prevents excessive engine braking, this reducing the effects on chassis behavior. This A&S clutch makes for quick, smooth downshifts.

points.title: Large 282mm Front Disc
points.description: A 2 pot calliper paired with large 282mm front disc gives accurate and strong braking power.

points.title: Yamaha’s 1st Glow-in-the-Dark Emblem
points.description: Stand out in any light. A one of a kind, glow in the dark emblem enhances Y16ZR’s presence, ensuring the brand’s dominance day or night.

points.title: Chameleon Effect
points.description: Featuring special UV graphics with a colour-shift effect, this design changes with the light, showcasing the bike’s refined aesthetics and commanding attention from every angle.

points.title: Unique Serial Number
points.description: Each Y16ZR Limited Edition bears unique serial number, marking it as a prestigious collector’s item crafted with superior attention to detail.

points.title: LCD Meter Panel
points.description: Next generation LCD meter panel with shift timing light and adequate easy to read information.

points.title: Dual Slant Position Lights and LED Headlight
points.description: Predator type dual slant position lights emphasise the next generation MT look with the central mounted LED headlight to ensure bright and superior night timing.

points.title: Inverted Front Fork
points.description: All new inverted front forks and cast aluminium upper triple clamp provides confident cornering and braking performance.

points.title: Front and Rear ABS Brakes
points.description: Equipped with dual channel ABS system for front and rear brakes provides sure stopping power in all weather conditions.

points.title: MT Series Air Scoop & Tank
points.description: The legendary MT series air scoop directs air for effective cooling and the refined naked fuel tank gives it the mass forward body design.

points.title: Slick LED Turn Signal Indicators
points.description: Slick and lightweight LED signal indicators with hazard lights function even when the ignition switch is off.

points.title: LED Rear Lights
points.description: Sophisticated rear LED lights provide a clear and distinct rear identity.

points.title: Ergonomic Motard Riding Position
points.description: With low seat height refined fuel tank incorporating sculpted knee area and high mounted handle bar to give it the motard and agile riding position.

points.title: Penarik Tuas Klac Lebih Pendek
points.description: Kini 10mm lebih pendek, ianya mampu memberikan cengkaman yang singkat dan lebih selesa ketika menukar gear.

points.title: Enjin 155CC Dengan VVA Serba Baru
points.description: Jantung penggerak paling berkuasa di kelasnya, enjin sejukan cecair 155cc serba baru, 4-lejang, 4-injap, SOHC dengan VVA.

points.title: Gearbox 6 Kelajuan Dengan Pemetaan Pencucuhan Individu untuk Setiap Gear
points.description: Menampilkan pemetaan pencucuhan yang berbeza untuk setiap gear, menghasilkan daya dorong 17.7Hp @ 9,500 rpm dan tork tertinggi 14.4 Nm @ 8,000 rpm.

points.title: Klac ‘Assist & Slipper’
points.description: Terhubung ke gearbox, sistem klac A&S memastikan penukaran gear yang lebih lancar dan mengurangkan tahap bebanan klac untuk menghasilkan perjalanan yang lebih selesa.

points.title: Kerangka Baru Serba Ringan
points.description: Dilengkapi dengan kolar tetulang berbentuk Y baharu serta pendakap enjin yang lebih tebal, pada ketebalan 4.5mm. Ia memastikan tunggangan anda lebih mantap dan prestasi kawalan selekoh yang optimum biarpun pada kelajuan tinggi.

points.title: Tangki Bahan Api 5.4 Liter Baru
points.description: Seiring dengan enjin yang cekap bahan api, Y16ZR mampu menawarkan jarak maksimum 256km dalam satu tangki penuh, berdasarkan pada gaya tunggangan anda.

points.title: Brek Cakera Depan Kaliper 2-Pot Baru
points.description: Angkup brek dua piston pada roda hadapan menawarkan kestabilan ketika membrek dengan saiz brek cakera hadapan yang berukuran 245mm.

points.title: Tempat Duduk Jenis Tepisah Gaya Baru
points.description: Rekaan pelana tempat duduk anti-gelincir yang ergonomik mengikut kontur duduk penunggang untuk tunggangan yang lebih selesa.

points.title: Lampu Depan LED Tinggi dan Rendah Berasingan
points.description: Terinspirasi dari sukan permotoran, lampu depan sinar rendah terletak di bahagian bar pemegang sementara sinar tinggi disatukan dengan lampu posisi, di bahagian bawah, memberikan penampilan bahagian hadapan sporty yang tiada bandingannya.

points.title: Lampu Belakang LED Baru
points.description: Tampil lebih bergaya, lebih ramping, lebih runcing dengan rekaan lampu belakang LED inspirasi daripada model YZF-R1, ia disatukan dengan sempurna pada kontur badan motosikal.

points.title: Meter Digital LCD Dengan Dasar Gelap
points.description: Panel unit digital LCD baharu yang memaparkan semua informasi seperti kelajuan, tahap rpm, kedudukan gear, penunjuk VVA dan lain-lain pada dasar yang gelap, memberikan kontras grafik yang jelas.

points.title: Sistem Kunci Pintar
points.description: Enjin boleh dihidupkan dengan mudah hanya dengan memutar butang tanpa perlu memasukkan kunci. Sistem ini juga mempunyai fungsi ‘panggil-balik’ untuk mencari kedudukan motosikal. Dilengkapi ‘immobilizer’ untuk mencegah kecurian.

points.title: Soket Kuasa 12V DC
points.description: Untuk memudahkan anda mengecas apa saja peralatan pintar anda, soket DC 12V dengan maksimum kapasiti 1.0A disediakan.

points.title: Suis Pemberhentian Enjin Baru
points.description: Anda boleh mematikan enjin segera dengan hanya menekan suis khusus yang digabungkan dengan suis utama, sekiranya berlaku kecemasan, demi keselamatan anda.
